description: The file defines the DeploymentBasedQueueBalancer class, which is a stream queue balancer that uses deployment information and silo status to distribute queues among silos in an Orleans distributed system. It manages silo states, creates resource balancers, and handles cluster membership changes to balance workloads effectively.

classes.name: DeploymentBasedQueueBalancer
classes.description: A stream queue balancer implementation that leverages deployment info and silo statuses to distribute queues based on resource balancing logic in Orleans.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DeploymentBasedQueueBalancer using dependency injection and a deployment configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the balancer with a given stream queue mapper, setting up queue discovery.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the list of queues assigned to this silo based on the balancing strategy, considering silo maturity and active statuses.
